summary: Frontend-only test of the rewritten MetricDetailDialog on /bi (superadmin login). Verified across all 5 hubs: dialog opens from every 'Rincian' button, 0 console errors in every run. SLS-06 PASS: hero 'Rp 382.500.000' + formula, donut with compact center 'Rp 382,5 jt / total', table Kategori/Nilai/Kontribusi with 55,6% / 44,4% / 0% / 0% inline bars and Total row 'Rp 382.500.000 / 100%', 'Bahan perhitungan' (Tagihan 4, Outstanding total 1.530.000.000), 'Sumber & cakupan data' (ar_invoices). SLS-01 PASS: both 'Pergerakan pada rentang ini' (area, 4 buckets) and 'Pecahan per kategori' (donut) charts + trend badge 'tetap vs sblm.'. Drill button bi-metric-detail-drill navigates to /finance?tab=ar&status=unpaid,partial and closes dialog; bi-metric-export href = <BACKEND>/api/analytics/export/SLS-06?date_from=2026-07-31&date_to=2026-08-29. Non-additive honesty PASS on SLS-02 and PRJ-01 (no Kontribusi column, no Total row, horizontal bars, 'Tiap kategori berdiri sendiri — satuannya tidak bisa dijumlahkan.'). Escape and X both close the dialog. Tabs smoke: eksekutif 15 cards, penjualan 18, marketing 7, proyek 12, tim 7; details opened on LED-01, LED-02, MKT-01, LED-09, PRJ-01, PRJ-02, USR-01, USR-02 — all render inputs + sources panels. One real defect found: the 'Pecahan per kategori' chart falls back to the SERIES data (not the breakdown) whenever the metric has a series AND the breakdown does not qualify for the donut (>6 rows or non-additive).

ui_bugs.issue: Section titled 'Pecahan per kategori' renders the time series instead of the category breakdown when rows>6 (or non-additive) and metric.series exists. MetricChart kind='auto' resolves to series whenever metric.series.length>0 (MetricChart.js L62/L67), and the dialog passes kind={rows.length<=6 && additive ? 'pie' : 'auto'}. Reproduced on LED-01 (penjualan): 8 breakdown rows in the table, but the chart is a single-dot area chart of 1 bucket (2026-08) — visually empty and mislabeled; same on USR-01 (8 rows, neither pie nor bars rendered). Fix: add an explicit 'bar'/'category' kind and pass it instead of 'auto' for the breakdown chart.

Sigma icon is rendered next to formulas whose text already starts with 'Σ', producing 'Σ Σ termin lewat tanggal & belum lunas' (SLS-06) and 'Σ Σ bobot langkah terverifikasi / Σ bobot' (PRJ-01). Same duplication on the cards. Strip a leading 'Σ'/'Σ ' from metric.formula when the icon is shown.

issues: Breakdown rows carry currency amounts (850.000.000 each) while the metric unit is a count, so the table formats them as bare numbers, adds Kontribusi 33,3% each and a Total row '2.550.000.000' — a total that has nothing to do with the headline value '3 unit'. Either label the value column with the breakdown's own unit or suppress Kontribusi/Total when the breakdown unit differs from the metric unit.
Donut center for SLS-01 shows '2.550.000.000' uncompacted (compact formatting only kicks in for currency/idr unit) — inconsistent with the SLS-06 'Rp 382,5 jt' center.
Three breakdown rows/legend entries share the identical label 'Tipe 45/90' (backend data), so table and donut legend are indistinguishable; consider appending unit code/id to the label.

action_items: HIGH: give MetricChart an explicit category/bar kind and use it for the 'Pecahan per kategori' chart so it never falls back to the series (LED-01, USR-01 currently show a single-dot series chart under that title).

MED: SLS-01 breakdown is in currency while the metric is a count — hide Kontribusi/Total (or label the unit) when breakdown unit != metric unit; also use compact format for the donut center for non-currency units.
LOW: avoid the double 'Σ Σ' when metric.formula already starts with Σ (dialog hero and MetricCard).
CODE: in MetricDetailDialog, `total ?` is a truthiness check — an additive breakdown whose values sum to 0 silently loses the Kontribusi column and the Total row; use `total !== null`.
critical_code_review_comments: MetricChart.js L62/L67: kind='auto' unconditionally prefers metric.series over metric.breakdown, which makes 'auto' unusable for a breakdown-specific chart slot — root cause of the LED-01/USR-01 wrong chart.
MetricDetailDialog.js L183/L211/L230: `total ?` should be `total !== null` (0-sum additive breakdowns lose Kontribusi/Total).
MetricDetailDialog table formats breakdown values with metric.unit; breakdown rows can be in a different unit (SLS-01), so % shares/Total can be meaningless.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/bi/MetricCard.js (added data-testid=bi-metric-card-detail + data-detail=<CODE> on the 'Rincian' button for test targeting)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use [data-detail="<METRIC_CODE>"] (new testid bi-metric-card-detail) to open a metric's Rincian dialog directly; tab testids are tab-page-tab-<key>. Dialog testids: bi-metric-detail, bi-metric-detail-table/-row, bi-metric-detail-drill, bi-metric-export, bi-chart. Retest after the chart-kind fix: LED-01 and USR-01 must show a horizontal bar chart of their 8 categories under 'Pecahan per kategori' (currently a single-dot series chart). SLS-06/SLS-01/SLS-02/PRJ-01 behaviours already verified and passing; 0 console errors observed on all tabs.
rca_of_the_issue: MetricDetailDialog renders the breakdown chart with kind={rows.length<=6 && additive ? 'pie' : 'auto'}. Inside MetricChart, kind='auto' resolves rows/isSeries from metric.series first (L62/L67), so any metric that has a series and >6 (or non-additive) breakdown rows draws the series again under the title 'Pecahan per kategori'. With a 1-bucket series (LED-01) the result is an almost empty chart with a single dot.
